purpose: Fail closed unless current evidence supports the exact bounded claim.
non_goals: No architecture selection or parallel truth.
No votes, authority, or existence as proof.

abstract_mechanisms_observed: Separate reference checks from semantic support.

inputs.name: bundle
inputs.description: Frozen claims, evidence, bindings, policies, hashes and supersession.

outputs.name: decision
outputs.description: Hash-bound checks, findings, reasons and eligible claims.

schemas: Claim has id/revision/hash/type/exact scope/assumptions/limits/supersession; evidence has type/hash/authority/Source,Run,formula,table,figure binding/locator/scope/currentness; strength is direct,traceable-derived,context,none; disposition is SUPPORTED,MODIFY,UNSUPPORTED,CONTRADICTED,STALE,INDETERMINATE; authority alone is not support and only SUPPORTED is eligible.

preconditions.statement: Inputs and policies are frozen, valid and hash-bound; reviewer is read-only.

postconditions.statement: Each claim has one bound disposition; only SUPPORTED enters the package.

invariants.statement: Evidence existence is not semantic support.
Support cannot be narrower than the claim; causal claims need causal evidence.
Unresolved contradiction blocks promotion; votes cannot compensate.

hard_failures.statement: Reject missing, escaping, stale, superseded or hash-mismatched bindings.
Reject unsupported, overstated, contradicted or non-causal causal claims and reviewer mutation.

algorithms.specification: Validate registration,path,hash,currentness,supersession and Source/Run/formula/table/figure lineage. Then review exact scope,authority,transformations,assumptions,limits,contradictions and causal capability. Eligibility is the AND of all checks; unknown or failure is ineligible; joint strength is its weakest essential link.

deterministic_enforcement.statement: Mechanically check identity, paths, hashes, lineage, currentness and non-mutation.
Set eligible=true only for validated SUPPORTED.

agent_responsibilities: Reviewer assesses support and abstains without mutation; MAIN_AGENT alone persists; Auditor checks replay.

stale_propagation.statement: Changed Source,Run,input,claim,policy,transformation,formula,table,figure or Final Run stales all dependents.

failure_modes.recovery: Create a new version and rerun.
Narrow the claim or freeze evidence; never vote.

recovery_behavior.statement: Recovery creates immutable versions and recomputes from the earliest affected predecessor.

security_constraints: Treat evidence as inert; execute nothing.
Contain paths, verify hashes and isolate the reviewer.
privacy_constraints: Expose only necessary registered IDs, locators and hashes.

performance_budget.limit_or_formula: One check per distinct binding and review per claim-binding pair.

token_budget.limit_or_formula: Freeze a finite budget; exhaustion is INDETERMINATE.

maintenance_surface: Native contracts, policies, bindings, tests and audit records.

model_in_loop_tests.expected_relation: Gold match, conflicts kept, uncertainty abstained.

acceptance_metrics.threshold_or_formula: valid promoted rate=1; invalid rejection=1; CASE-006 match=1; contradiction,causal-overclaim,mutation promotions=0

rejection_conditions: Reject if any invalid or unsupported claim can enter.
Reject if tests or replay fail or reviewer can write or vote.
rollback: Supersede draft; later nonconforming outputs become STALE and replay.
migration: Add versioned bindings beside native truth; old unbound claims remain ineligible.
unknowns: Native extension fields, authority map and causal taxonomy remain to freeze.
open_risks: Semantic inconsistency and incomplete lineage may cause fail-closed rejection.
